name: Bug Hunt
description: 复现并定位问题，给出最小修复和验证路径。Use when a reported bug needs reproduction, root-cause localization, a minimal fix, and a verification path.

commands.description: Reproduce, localize, and minimally fix a bug
commands.injectPrompt: Apply the bug-hunt skill: first reproduce the bug with a minimal case, then localize the root cause via bisection and evidence gathering, propose the smallest correct fix, and define a verification path that proves the fix.
